steps.text: Click Here To View The Latest Parish Newsletter In Pdf Forma

operator_notes: Shared Camus/Clonleigh/Leckpatrick pastoral-area newsletter is genuinely
6 pages — default cap of 4 was rejecting real content as oversized.
Wait for widget to load, then pick newest View Newsletter row.
Ignore Gift Aid and Data Entry PDFs in the menu.
The real newsletter link is hosted on www.odyc.net/camus/<DDMMYY>.pdf —
NOT under a '/pdf/' folder, so a[href*="/pdf/"] never matched it and
only ever matched the external drumraghparish.com Privacy Policy link
(rejected as non-bulletin, producing a hard failure). Widened selector
to a[href*="pdf"] (substring, no folder assumption) to match it.
NOTE: this parish shares one PDF (Camus, Clonleigh & Leckpatrick
confirmed byte-identical across all three sites. As of 2026-08-09/10
the file served under the current week's filename still contains the
PREVIOUS week's content (2nd August, not 9th) — a parish-secretary
upload lag, not a scraper bug; flag for human review if recurring.
do_not: Do not pick admin PDFs from the widget list.
